rounds.text: IL&FS Investment Managers Ltd presents a compelling case for investors focused on balance sheet integrity and a nascent operational turnaround. The company is effectively debt-free with zero borrowings [E38, E40, E59] and maintains a robust current ratio of 5.02x, signaling exceptional short-term liquidity [E39]. Recent performance metrics highlight a significant shift in momentum, with trailing twelve-month sales growth reaching 111% [E17] and quarterly operating margins improving by 26 percentage points compared to the year-ago period [E31]. This operational efficiency is further validated by a strong cash conversion ratio of 4.48x, ensuring that reported profits are fully backed by actual cash flow [E34, E37]. Conceded: the company faces long-term challenges with compounded profit growth of -23% over ten years [E18] and a low return on equity of 1.9% [E13]. Nevertheless, the stock offers a substantial dividend yield of 15.40% [E4, E60], providing a tangible return while the business executes its recovery strategy.
